text:
sofia (PM): Quick thread we need a single GA runbook for Private (VPC/on-prem). Focus: acceptance criteria, pilot order, and what we require from customer. GA target in 6w.
lee (eng): Essentials: preflight, dry-run network validation, non-destructive rolling upgrades, documented manual rollback. Also snapshot hooks preferred.
omar (field): Pilot asks: 1) one low-risk VPC pilot (k8s provider NAT), 2) one on-prem with customer NAT device, 3) optional air-gapped customer later. Need clear signoff checklist.
trina (netops): Must include IP ownership policy + required CIDR allocations. If customer will manage SNAT/DNAT, we need an ops responsibility matrix signed.
kai (infra): For rollback we need retained etcd/snapshot TTL >= upgrade window. We can expose `snapshot-ttl` flag. Otherwise rollback is manual.
uzma (QA): I'll own acceptance tests. Proposals: a) Preflight suite (CIDR overlap, route table checks, firewall rules), b) Upgrade smoke (k8s pods scheduled, ingress reachable), c) Post-upgrade connectivity (10 sample flows).
sofia (PM): Measurables for gates: preflight passes in 3/3 lab topologies, dryrun validated in 2 pilot customers, upgrade non-destructive <=98% IP retention in testbench, rollback within 20m for automated case.
lee (eng): Implementation notes: we add `--dryrun-network` into installer that runs probes and returns report JSON (no changes). Also operator annotates tenants with `upgrade-phase` and supports `canary=true` label.
omar (field): Dryrun report must be human readable + machine-friendly for field. Example: `DRYRUN OK: route 10.0.10.0/24 -> gateway OK` or `FAIL: firewall port 443 blocked (remediation: open port on CPE)`
trina (netops): Add KMS/HSM gating: if customer supplies CMK, include kms-verify step in preflight. If not, platform-managed is used but documented.
ux-bot: NOTE: Add checklist item - "Customer provides lead netops contact + maintenance window".
lee (eng): Tests we will run in CI: single-NAT, symmetric-NAT, provider-NAT, and an on-prem firewall shim. We'll assert no IP reassignment and service continuity.
uzma (QA): I'll add `acceptance/private/preflight.yaml`, `acceptance/private/upgrade-smoke.yaml`, `acceptance/private/rollback-timing.yaml`.
sofia (PM): Prioritization: MUST for GA - preflight, dryrun, canary rollout, signoff checklist, docs for manual rollback. NICE - GUI IPAM, automatic re-mapping helpers, full snapshot-rollback automation (GA+1).
kai (infra): Resource ask: 2 sprint cycle to implement snapshot hooks + operator revert. If that's delayed, we ship GA with documented manual snapshot/restore steps.
omar (field): Customer comms: we must publish "Known limitations" that call out: CPE that rewrites source IP, overlapping CIDR with provider, and carrier-grade NAT edge cases.
trina (netops): Also add SLO note: for customer-managed NAT we do not guarantee external IP continuity during scaling; document and require a signed responsibility matrix.
lee (eng): Suggested preflight error format for UX: `ERROR: CIDR conflict: customer 172.16.0.0/16 overlaps cluster 172.16.0.0/12  remediation: https://redwood/docs/private#preflight-cidr`
ux-bot: ACTIONS: #4711 create dryrun feature, #4712 CI topologies, #4713 rollback docs.
sofia (PM): Action owners and dates:
- lee: PR for `--dryrun-network` + sample error strings (due Thu)
- trina: KMS checklist and responsibility matrix template (due Tue)
- uzma: acceptance test definitions (due Fri)
- omar: pilot outreach and signoff checklist (due next Wed)
- kai: snapshot hooks estimate (due Wed)
sofia (PM): If all MUSTs pass in pilots and CI, we proceed to GA. If any MUST is missing, release as Beta and schedule GA+1 for remaining items. Revisit in weekly shiproom. :thumbsup:
